Please edit this parent email. Under 120 words, no pleasantries. I have a few minutes before fifth period, my prep ends at 11:55. Pasting below.

Dear Parents,

I hope this finds you well. I am writing to let you know about lab safety rules in my chemistry classes. I teach five sections, and this email goes to all of them. Our first unit, measurement and lab safety, runs through mid-September, and we will be doing hands-on labs the whole time. Every student must wear splash goggles during labs. No goggles, no lab. I am short six pairs for the Unit 1 labs, so if you can send in a pair with your student, that would help a great deal. Students must also wear closed-toe shoes and tie back long hair. I will go over everything at back-to-school night.

Thank you,
Ms. Tolentino

Here is the edited version (92 words):

Subject: Chemistry lab safety and goggles

Parents,

My chemistry classes begin hands-on labs immediately. Our first unit, measurement and lab safety, runs through mid-September.

Lab rules:
1. Students must wear splash goggles during every lab. No goggles, no lab.
2. Closed-toe shoes are required.
3. Long hair must be tied back.

I am short six pairs of goggles for the Unit 1 labs. If possible, please send a pair with your student.

I will review all of this at back-to-school night.

Ms. Tolentino

I removed the opener and the line about five sections, since the email works for any class. Want it shorter?
Good. Shorter by ten words. Salamat.
